verdict.rationale: Martin can act inside specific applications via integrations (calendar, email, Slack, notes, to-dos) rather than through general screen/GUI-level control of arbitrary desktop apps — it operates named services via API-like connections, not a computer-use style visual agent. A desktop app exists (martin-comm-4) but evidence only shows it syncing to-dos, not controlling arbitrary programs. Missing for 10: evidence of generic screen/vision-based computer control, ability to operate arbitrary (non-integrated) applications, and independent hands-on proof of this broader 'operate any app' capability.
